M-Extension-Server bundled component
====================================

Niratan includes the Windows x64 runtime bundle from:
https://github.com/kodjodevf/M-Extension-Server

Bundled version: 1.0.4
Source commit: e86c8c627a628f71b52cfa70cd1435cacc96c190
License: Mozilla Public License 2.0

The corresponding source is available at:
https://github.com/kodjodevf/M-Extension-Server/tree/e86c8c627a628f71b52cfa70cd1435cacc96c190

Niratan loads the MPL-2.0 compatibility overlay in the adjacent `overlay`
directory before the upstream server JAR. The overlay adds a string-valued
`sourceId` request field, selects that source from multi-source APKs before
delegating to the upstream invoker, and repairs a narrow invalid constructor
pattern produced by dex2jar for recent R8 output.

M-Extension-Server includes AndroidCompat and code derived from the Mihon,
Aniyomi, and Suwayomi projects. Their notices and applicable licenses are
described by the upstream project:
https://github.com/kodjodevf/M-Extension-Server/blob/e86c8c627a628f71b52cfa70cd1435cacc96c190/README.md

The bundled JRE carries its own legal notices under the runtime's legal
directory.
